canonical_statement: For every n >= 1 and 1 < p < infinity, there is a nonnegative C depending only on n and p such that every real-valued smooth compactly supported u on R^n has the L^p norm of its Frechet Hessian bounded by C times the L^p norm of its Laplacian.
domain_and_universes: n : Nat; p : ENNReal; u : (Fin n -> Real) -> Real; Prop in universe 0; Lebesgue volume on the finite Pi space
conclusion: eLpNorm (fun x => norm (hessian u x)) p volume <= ENNReal.ofReal C * eLpNorm (laplacian u) p volume

encoding_decisions.laplacian: trace of that Hessian on the standard coordinate vectors
